assets.prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. ORIGINAL premium football deduction game hero background artwork. Generate landscape 3:1 at high resolution. CRITICAL COMPOSITION: this image will be center-cropped to an extremely shallow 5:1 website banner. Put ALL important objects ONLY WITHIN THE MIDDLE 52% OF THE IMAGE HEIGHT (from y=24% to y=76%). Top quarter and bottom quarter must be just soft pale blue stadium atmosphere and light, absolutely NO heads or bodies there. On RIGHT 58% of image width, two SMALL anonymous male footballers in opposing three-quarter back view, from waist up. Entire heads including hair fit well inside middle band, heads start at y=27%, shoulders around y=43%, waist ends y=70%. One cobalt blue jersey figure centered x=64%, one crimson red jersey figure centered x=82%. They are seen from behind, their faces not visible. A sharp painterly diagonal blue-versus-red lightning slash separates them. Around their waists within the middle band are floating little silver frosted portrait scouting cards with dark headshot silhouettes. All important objects within y=24%-76%, NO BIG CLOSE-UP PEOPLE. Full canvas background an airy white and icy blue football stadium, soft white floodlights, light crystalline blue paint accents, spacious white mist on LEFT 43% reserved for live HTML heading. At top and bottom only atmospheric stadium haze that can be cropped away. Refined realistic sports video-game key art, detailed clothing texture and fine rim lighting, bright blue and crimson color contrast. NO words, NO letters, NO logos, NO crowns, NO arrows, NO scribbles, NO marks or question marks on either footballer's head or body, NO watermarks, NO interface elements, NO borders. This must be newly created original art, not derived or traced from a screenshot.
